content: Is there a prefered choice between writing interval integrals (∫ t in a..b) and set integrals like (∫ t in Ioc a b)? I know they're the same for a≤ba\leq ba≤b but different otherwise. See for example NumberTheory/AbelSummation which seems to use them interchangeably. Maybe it doesn't matter but it'd be nice to be consistent and not have to keep rewriting between the two forms.
Perhaps we should use interval integrals for integrals over intervals
